retrievalProfile.description: A vertical split composition featuring a warm-toned photographic portrait on the left and heavy, wavy display typography on a clean white field on the right.

recipe.visualDefinition: A classic mid-century record sleeve design characterized by a warm, grainy portrait of a female vocalist occupying the left two-thirds, contrasted by a stark white vertical panel on the right containing large-scale, distorted serif lettering in a muted salmon hue, anchored by a solid blue horizontal footer.
coreVisualRelationships: Warm portrait tones against a stark white typographic column
Organic, wavy letterforms echoing the curves of the subject
Heavy horizontal blue footer grounding the vertical composition
Tight cropping on the subject to emphasize emotional expression
coreInvariants: Vertical split between image and text
Wavy, liquid-like distortion on display fonts
Muted, desaturated color palette with one primary blue anchor

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is positioned in the left two-thirds, medium shot from the waist up, slightly angled toward the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The solid cobalt blue bar at the bottom serves as the structural foundation.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the subject's face, move right to the large display text, and then down to the blue footer information.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant negative space is utilized in the white right-hand column to make the typography pop.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm sepia and peach tones in the photography.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pure white background for the text panel.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Cobalt blue for the bottom footer and salmon-pink for the display text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low-to-medium saturation with a vintage matte finish; high value contrast between the white panel and the dark hair/blue bar.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid neon or high-vibrancy digital colors
Limit to warm earth tones, white, and one primary cool tone

letterConstructionRules: Vertical stems are distorted with a liquid, wavy ripple effect
characterSpecificRedesigns: The letter 'S' and 'B' feature exaggerated, fluid curves that mimic 1960s psychedelic styles
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast heavy, distorted display type with small, clean, geometric metadata text.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and rounded serifs to apply the wavy distortion.
Captures the mid-century geometric feel for secondary metadata.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a warm, grainy 1950s-style portrait of a woman in a white dress against a peach-colored curtain, occupying the left 60% of the frame. The right 40% should be a solid white vertical panel. Add a solid cobalt blue horizontal bar across the bottom 10% of the entire image.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply large, salmon-pink, wavy-distorted all-caps serif text in the white panel. Place small, clean blue monospaced text between the large text blocks. Add technical metadata in white sans-serif inside the blue footer bar.

verificationChecks: Is the text in the right panel wavy and distorted?
Is there a clear vertical divide between the photo and the white panel?
Is the footer bar solid blue?
Is the color palette limited to peach, salmon, white, and blue?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the wavy text distortion
Width of the white typographic column
Specific hue of the salmon-pink text
mustRedesign: Avoid using modern high-definition digital textures
Ensure the wavy text remains legible despite the distortion
postGenerationChecks: Check for grain consistency across the photo and white panel
Ensure the blue footer is perfectly horizontal
Verify the wavy text is stacked vertically in the right column
Confirm the subject's skin tones are warm and naturalistic
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait(Left 60%) + White Panel(Right 40%) + Blue Footer(Bottom 10%) + Wavy Display Type(Salmon) = Mid-Century Soul Aesthetic.
